A 16-bit ISO13239 1st complement checksum is added to the end. The
             checksum spans all bytes except the checksum itself. The checksum is
             verified by calculating the checksum of all bytes, including the checksum
             field. This shall give a fixed residual of 0xf0b8 if the checksum is valid. If
             the checksum is invalid, the OTP shall be rejected.
